title: Atsu's final duel with Saito in Ghost of Yotei
subject: atsu
description:
Did Atsu make the right choice at the end? 👇

The final duel beneath the ginkgo tree and what Atsu chose after her revenge. Spoilers for the ending of Ghost of Yotei.

scenes.text: Atsu's revenge ended exactly where it began, beneath the ginkgo tree.
Lord Saito took her niece Kiku hostage and waited at Atsu's childhood home.
He told her they were the same, both living only for revenge.
But she had something new to live for: her brother Jubei and his daughter.
Then Saito struck Jubei down. Atsu pinned Saito to the ginkgo tree, just as he had once pinned her.
As Jubei died, she promised to raise Kiku far from vengeance.
